task_title: H1 Build-deterministic AI equipment loadout scoring

plan_review.notes: Alt A: State-delta scorer (full-state delta, no displacement cost) — ADOPTED as the main architecture change (fixes double-counting). Alt B: Abstract combat model (beat-level simulation per encounter shape) — rejected as over-engineered for H1; full-state delta retains most benefit. Alt C: Persona/utility re-use (weapon-personas.ts) — rejected; does not handle generated instances or ERV breakdown. Blocking changes adopted: (1) full-state delta replaces item-centric additive+displacement — fixes double-counting; (2) added nonEquipmentModifiers to context — caller pre-extracts from world; (3) ability scoring now models grant source counts and net gained/lost; (4) DPS uses accuracy*critMult; full effective state from computeEffectiveStatsFromLoadout; (5) cooldownMs/1000 for per-second DPS. Non-blocking: defense uses armor-reduction semantics; purchaseCostPenalty removed from H1 API; encounter-fit from snapshot aoeRadius not tags; remainingFractionDiscount only on ability-access component; encumbrance uses hypothetical STR thresholds; use resolvedEffects not frozen.abilityGrants.
